request.style: English, warm male solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light drums, hopeful and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Many drew accounts of fulfilled things
Held by eyes that saw from the start
I searched deep for truth and proof
To write an orderly report

[Chorus]
Most excellent Theophilus hear
Know the certainty of what you learned
From the start to the finish clear
The word is sure and firmly stirred

[Verse]
My first book told what He began
To do and teach in the land
Then He gave instructions by the Spirit
To chosen ones who waited

[Chorus]
Most excellent Theophilus hear
Know the certainty of what you learned
From the start to the finish clear
The word is sure and firmly stirred

[Bridge]
A sound from heaven filled the room
Tongues of fire upon each one
Filled with the Spirit they spoke
Boldly proclaiming the Lord's hope

[Outro]
Two years in Rome he stayed
Teaching with complete boldness displayed
